_doc: Perception, threat, aim and the action executors' numbers (Update 03 sections 2, 4, 5; gravelight/bots/bot_perception.gd, bot_aim.gd, bot_actions.gd).

perception._doc: Sight: a fov_deg cone from the eye out to sight_range_m, rays_per_think line-of-sight rays per think (nearest first; walls and closed doors block). Hearing (no line of sight needed): any zombie within groan_m, a sprinter within sprinter_m, one tearing boards within tear_m, a boss within boss_m. What a bot or a teammate perceived stays known for memory_s (the squad blackboard), at the last place it was perceived. No wallhacks.

threat._doc: Threat per zombie = proximity (1 - d / range_m)^prox_exp x the speed tier's tier_mult x the type multiplier (ai_counters.json threat_mult) x targeting_me (it chases this bot) or targeting_downed (a downed teammate) x behind (outside the bot's view cone) x outside_window (still outside a barricade). Threat pressure = the sum / pressure_norm, clamped to 0..1.

aim._doc: Target choice: threat x the counters' priority, + specials_first (personality) for specials/bosses, x vulnerable_priority / grab_priority (counters), x escort_bonus for what goes for the escorted player; kill-steal etiquette until kill_steal_until_round: a zombie under kill_steal_hp_frac of its health that the human is shooting is left to them unless it threatens someone. Headshot chance = base_head by weapon class x skill head_aim_mult + personality / counter head_bias, + slow_or_close_head for slow or close targets. Fire discipline: autos burst (burst_s / pause_s) beyond burst_range_m and fire freely inside it; semi rifles single shots at the skill's semi_max_rpm; nothing beyond max_range_m[class] (no spraying what it can't hit); never through a teammate (a 0.6 m line-of-fire check).
aim._sights_doc: T-058 fire discipline: it fires only with the sights on the target (within sights_on_mult x body_half_width_m at its range, as a person sees their crosshair) and when the shot's current spread (hip / aimed, bloom, on the move) fits within spray_width_mult x body_half_width_m at that range.
aim._body_doc: T-058: the fire tolerance never goes below the angle a target's half width (body_half_width_m) covers at its range: point-blank, anything on the body is a hit.
aim._quick_switch_doc: T-058: a new target within quick_switch_deg of where it already aims is a flick (quick_switch_s), not a fresh reaction delay.

weapons._doc: Weapon choice: the class value (class_value) x the personality's class_pref x the situation (crowd_bonus for crowd classes when crowd_n or more are within 10 m, single_bonus for single-target classes on a boss, close_bonus for close classes within close_m) x ammo (an empty magazine: empty_mag_mult; nothing at all: 0). The pistol trap fix: the bot goes back to its best gun as soon as nothing is within swap_back_safe_m (or the worse gun runs dry), and never stays on the pistol while a better gun has ammo.
weapons._weak_doc: T-058: after weak_pistol_after_round a plain (not upgraded) pistol is worth weak_pistol_mult and isn't a loaded gun to swap to instead of reloading: its magazine no longer kills one zombie.

reload._doc: Reload intelligence: reload when the magazine is under low_frac and the pressure under low_pressure with nothing within near_block_m, or when it's empty. Never with a sprinter within sprinter_block_m or anything within near_block_m: swap to another loaded gun instead, or knife. Between waves every gun is topped up.

grenades._doc: Frags only into a group of min_group or more within group_radius_m of a point min_dist_m..max_dist_m away that no teammate is within teammate_clear_m of, or on a boss; cooldown_s between throws. personality grenade_bias scales min_group down (Peg) and the skill's grenade_skill the throw's accuracy.

melee._doc: The knife: crawlers within range_m, or a lone zombie (nothing else within lone_radius_m) in rounds up to early_round_max for the melee Scrip; anything in reach when every gun is dry. Never a boss (never_melee).

totenglocke._doc: The Totenglocke (the holder's rules in totenglocke.gd): quick tolls at what the cone reaches; the Great Toll only on great_min or more zombies bunched within great_bunch_m inside the great cone; the Bell Dome (dome) when reviving or covering with dome_min_pressure or more.

revive._doc: Revives (section 5): claimed on the squad blackboard by the nearest healthy bot with a safe path (path_safety_m: no known zombie that close to the path; medic_discount_m off the path length for the Medic). blocked_sprinter_m / blocked_bleed_s: no start with a sprinter that close to the downed one while more than that much bleed-out is left; last_chance_s: under that, go anyway. A second bot covers (cover claim) when the threat at the downed spot is over cover_threat. Mid-revive it only stops for something in knife reach while more than last_chance_s are left. Priority: the human, then bots, then Jakub (options.revive_priority).
revive._abort_doc: T-058: mid-hold, under abort_hp_frac health with something within 2 m and more than abort_min_left_s of the hold to go (and more than last_chance_s of bleed-out), it lets go and fights.
revive._self_swarm_doc: T-058: a reviver with self_swarm_n or more zombies within self_swarm_m of itself deals with them first (the revive counts as blocked: cover / fight / back off) while more than self_swarm_bleed_s of bleed-out are left.

train._doc: The squad's training route: the usable TrainingRoute (data/gravelight/ai/routes_<map>.json) whose line passes nearest the leader, within route_max_m on their floor; else the locomotion layer's free loop round the human.

fight._doc: T-058: Fight backs off (shooting) from the nearest zombie inside backpedal_base_m + its speed x backpedal_per_speed_s (a reach plus what it closes in a reaction), clamped to backpedal_min_m..backpedal_max_m: earlier from a runner than from a walker.
fight._stack_doc: In a special round (or against a hold_ground enemy) there is no backpedal; a bot more than stack_m from its nearest teammate (with nothing within 2.5 m) closes up to stand back to back.

hunt._doc: T-058: when a round has nothing left to spawn and only max_left zombies alive for after_s seconds (a boss loose elsewhere, a stuck straggler), the squad hears the last one (blackboard, no line of sight) and the bots with nothing else to do walk to it.

retreat._doc: T-058: it sprints clear (no shooting) only from something at least sprint_from_speed fast within sprint_within_m (runners, sprinters); slower ones it out-walks while shooting. Still within cornered_m after sprint_cornered_s of that: it turns and fights for fight_back_s.

powerups._doc: Power-up etiquette: always_take when it's safe; the rest (Death's Door, Double Scrip, Blackout, Clearance) only with the human within shared_m of it too, or no human in the match. Never one the human is walking toward (within toward_cone_deg of their heading, within toward_m).

hold._doc: Early rounds: bots hold windows in pairs (a window claimed by up to pair_size bots) and rebuild between kills; the window's room side, spread stand_spread_m apart. Later the utility scores move them to training.

callouts._doc: Squad callouts with world pings (BotPings): sprinter_behind_m: a sprinter that close behind a teammate (outside their view) is called; ping_s: how long a ping marker stays.
